name.text: Permutations I 4 - Complete the nPr steps (drag and drop)

questiontext.text:
Complete the working by dragging the correct item into each box. Remember: nPr = n! ÷ (n − r)!

Part A: A bus has 8 passengers waiting and 3 seats. Find 8P3, the number of ways to seat 3 of them.

  1. Substitute n = 8 and r = 3: 8P3 = 8! ÷ [[1]]
  2. Expand 8! only as far as the denominator: (8 × 7 × 6 × [[1]]) ÷ [[1]]
  3. Cancel the common factor, leaving 8 × 7 × [[2]]
  4. Multiply: 8P3 = [[3]]

Part B: A school elects a Prefect and an Assistant Prefect from 10 candidates. Find 10P2.

  1. Two positions are filled, so r = [[4]]
  2. 10P2 = 10 × [[5]]
  3. 10P2 = [[6]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution

\(_8P_3 = \dfrac{8!}{(8-3)!} = \dfrac{8!}{5!} = 8 \times 7 \times 6 = 336\)

\(_{10}P_2 = \dfrac{10!}{8!} = 10 \times 9 = 90\)

The formula leaves only \(r\) descending factors, starting at \(n\). Do not multiply all the way down to 1.
